content: निराकृ €8 <ab>U.</ab> ²1 To expel, drive away, repudiate; उग्रंपश्येन सुग्रीवस्तेन भ्राता निराकृतः <ls>Bk. 6. 100</ls>; <ls>R. 14. 57</ls>. .²2 To refute (as an opinion). .²3 To give up, abandon. .²4 To destroy completely, annihilate. .²5 To revile, contemn, slight. .²6 To oppose, obstruct, contradict. .²7 To refuse, decline, reject. .²8 To omit. .²9 To disappoint, frustrate.
